Research summary: MT reports Q3 2026 results on Nov 5, before the open, so the 5-day window turns on one print. Against that, Q2 missed forecasts, net debt rose to $9.5bn, and the Kryvyi Rih idling and tariff headlines add risk, so the setup is close to balanced with a slight lean positive. It is the one semi-equipment name showing relative strength against a falling tech sector, with a freshly turning chart near support. Research summary: Qnity reports Q3 2026 results before the open on Nov 4, so a hard catalyst sits inside the 5-day window. Sales growth accelerated from 10% for FY2025 to 18% in Q1 and 22% in Q2, and guidance was raised twice. Against that, the stock is down 12.3% over 20 days, GAAP earnings are falling, and the Q3 outlook is only low single-digit sequential growth, so the print could go either way. Not investment advice.
